# PHP security updates

This release rebuilds PHP-FPM and cron to address
[CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619](https://www.php.net/archive/2026.php#2026-10-21-5),
the two critical PHP vulnerabilities disclosed on October 21, 2026.
([575ff60](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/commit/575ff60))

## Upgrade instructions

Update the CLI, check the proposed release, then upgrade the stack:

```sh
kvsctl update-cli
kvsctl check
kvsctl upgrade
```

Updating the CLI alone does not replace PHP. The stack upgrade downloads
the signed release's pinned images and recreates the services. It preserves
the installation's PHP and MariaDB series. This release requires
`kvsctl 26.10.2` or newer and introduces no database migration.

## PHP-FPM and cron

| PHP series | Version shipped |
| --- | --- |
| 8.1 | 8.1.34 with the PHP security team's source backport |
| 8.2 | 8.2.35 |
| 8.3 | 8.3.36 |
| 8.4 | 8.4.27 |

PHP 8.2, 8.3 and 8.4 use the updated official Docker bases, pinned by digest.
PHP 8.1's official Docker images remain at the unpatched 8.1.34 build, so
both KVS images rebuild PHP with the
[official backport](https://github.com/php/php-src/commit/1d7dec178a094e6e75b229ce22754045f8c6070a).
The patch is pinned by commit and SHA-256; extensions use the same patched
sources. The build rejects older vulnerable bases for PHP 8.2 through 8.4.

PHP 8.1 still reports `8.1.34`; its version number alone cannot identify
the backport. The release image includes the applied commit in
`/usr/local/share/php-security/php81.commit`. PHP 8.1 remains end of life:
this exceptional backport is not a return to upstream support. Its minimal
fix terminates a worker on memory exhaustion without running application
shutdown callbacks; FPM replaces the worker for subsequent requests.

## Other changes

- Refresh the pinned Nginx and Debian base images used by this release.
- Build the CLI with Go 1.27.3 to address
  [GO-2026-6809](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6809) in certificate validation.
- Keep image download progress compact across SSH terminal sizes.
  ([9e50a5a](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/commit/9e50a5a))
- Include the Go dependency and development-check updates already on main.
  ([0186c2b](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/commit/0186c2b))

[Full comparison with 26.10.2](https://github.com/MaximeMichaud/KVS-install/compare/26.10.2...26.10.3)
